title: Nell and the Jug
note: b412 — Phase 3, 26-sound stage. Non-fiction note: bees really do visit water sources, not only flowers.

pages.brief: Nell the bee landing on the rim of a watering jug in a vegetable patch.
Close view of water glistening around the rim of a jug.
Nell the bee settling carefully on a wet jug rim.
Nell the bee dipping down to sip a little water from a jug's rim.
Nell the bee sipping again and again, clearly thirsty on a hot day.
Nell the bee pausing, checking her balance on a rim before sipping once more.
Nell the bee sipping calmly and steadily, perfectly balanced on a jug.
Nell the bee resting happily on a jug rim in the sun, refreshed.
